title: coccoloba caracasana f. glabra
intro: Coccoloba caracasana f. glabra, commonly known as the smooth coastal cordia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Polygonaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and other respiratory issues, as well as offering anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Coccoloba caracasana f. glabra include its ability to exhibit analgesic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate pain, prevent infections, and promote the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
